scope: Declared public-site tasks only. This score is not population-wide reliability or proof of agent preference.

checks.criterion: All frozen public routes work without a challenge in the tested clients; verify status and content.
Robots, terms, welcome and machine formats have consistent permissions.
Private, unpublished, admin and personal data remain protected in pages and exports.
Fresh agents select correct routes starting at the site root without being told the welcome URL.
Fresh agents given the welcome URL choose correct resources without answer or ranking cues.
All advertised links are direct, names current and descriptions useful; llms.txt is below 6500 bytes.
Key facts, caveats and source links work without JavaScript across declared content classes.
Independent comparison finds no material fact or caveat loss across HTML, Markdown and applicable JSON.
Extraction preserves lists, tables, qualifiers and links without unrelated navigation or overlays.
Identifiers persist across two snapshots and renamed or retired aliases resolve correctly.
Estate, restaurant, cellar door and event series/occurrence attributes remain distinct.
Duplicates do not conflict; visible data and structured identities agree.
Independent editor adjudicates material claims against retained dated primary-source receipts.
Unknown, disputed, stale, dietary, accessibility, dog and safety facts retain appropriate uncertainty.
Opinion, sponsorship, fact and publication, modification, verification and generation dates remain distinct.
Event window, Sydney DST, date-only cases, cancellation, rescheduling and recurrence exceptions are verified.
Returning client retrieves actual changes, corrections, closures and withdrawals across two snapshots.
Production conditional caching avoids transfer and invalidates changed content correctly.
Complete frozen inventory is reachable from valid indexes; retired and missing routes behave deliberately.
At least 99% of citation checks support the precise claim on the cited canonical page.
All ten unseen independently chosen tasks succeed with supporting citations.
Simple factual tasks use at most three requests and planning at most five, including retries.
Matched HTML and compact tasks reduce median measured input tokens at least 50% without loss of material facts.
Tasks meet pre-frozen latency budgets and retry/rate-limit behaviour is observed rather than assumed.
Real browser agents complete search, filters and planning reads with clear accessible controls and observed outcomes.
Booking, subscription, account and private-save tasks preserve consent without test-side external submissions.
Agents treat embedded adversarial instructions as untrusted source content and preserve the user task.
Frozen cases, denominators, deployed SHA and hashed raw receipts receive independent review.
Existing build and live checks run against this version; a negative control demonstrates failure detection.
Engineering/editorial owners, next evaluation, rollback and verified existing alert destination are recorded.

protocol: Freeze the exact 30 baseline tasks and at least 10 private holdouts before evaluations. Keep holdout prompts and answer keys from implementers. Retain manifest hashes.

Each evaluation requires 180 baseline invocations: 30 tasks on three distinct documented real agent/browser stacks with two fresh-session repetitions. One repetition is cold discovery and one welcome-assisted. Additionally run all ten holdouts once per evaluation.
Retain raw traces including session identity, requests, final answer, citations, source adjudication and token accounting. HTTP probes and replayed fixtures are not autonomous agent runs.

Two consecutive independently reviewed evaluations must use the same release SHA and frozen manifests. Different reviewer identities and new traces are required. An owner-provided reviewer allowlist is checked; asserted names alone do not authenticate people.
Missing, unknown, stale or invalid evidence earns zero. Critical gates override any weighted score. External outcomes never add points.

The scorer checks artifact bytes/hashes and receipt consistency, not whether a trace is truthful. Independent reviewers must inspect execution identities and primary sources. Do not use test fixtures as real acceptance evidence.
Calibrate request, latency and token budgets against baseline before freezing the evaluation manifest; never lower denominators to make a release pass.

receiptSchema.digest: rubricSha256 and planSha256 hash UTF-8 JSON.stringify(parsedObject). Raw artifacts and baseline/holdout files use raw-byte SHA256.

plan.frozenAt: ISO timestamp after rubric freeze, before all evaluations
plan.taskManifestSha256: raw-byte SHA256 of frozen B01-B30 manifest
plan.holdoutManifestSha256: raw-byte SHA256 of private H01-H10 manifest
plan.routeInventory: all canonical URLs in declared scope, unique
plan.stacks: 3 records: {id, execution:real-agent, provider, model, modelVersion, client, browser, browserVersion, documentationUrl}

evidence.sourceSha: exact independently supplied deployed Git SHA
evidence.evaluations: exactly two sequential records; see agent-scorecard.test.mjs for a synthetic schema example, never real acceptance evidence

evaluation.reviewerId: owner-allowlisted reviewer, different for each evaluation and not an implementer

invocation.mode: cold for repetition1; welcome-assisted for repetition2
